entities.summary: The Chapel of St Peter-on-the-Wall, Bradwell-on-Sea, is a Christian church dating from the years 660–662 and among the oldest largely intact churches in England. It is in regular use by the nearby Othona Community, in addition to Church of England services. It is a Grade I listed building. Chapel of St Peter-on-the-Wall is a chapel in Europe, established in 654 CE. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
